name: plumbline
description: A plumb line for AI coding — agent skills that check code against the philosophy of software design.

review_on_stop.title: Review on stop
review_on_stop.description: When a turn writes a lot of code (or creates a code file), ask Claude once to run the red-flags skill on those files before it finishes. Off by default.

review_threshold_lines.title: Review threshold (lines)
review_threshold_lines.description: Lines of code written in one turn that trigger the review on stop.
